Annotations.description: Annotations maps annotation keys to arbitrary string values.

type.description:
Type identifies the metric-source type, such as Prometheus or Datadog.
The consuming implementation defines the accepted values.

connectionDetails.description:
ConnectionDetails contains implementation-defined connection data encoded as JSON,
such as endpoints or authentication settings.

DataSourceSpec.description: DataSourceSpec defines a metric-source type and its implementation-defined connection data.

DurationShorthand.description: A shorthand representation of time duration, e.g. '1m', '10d', '2w'.

Labels.description: Labels maps label keys to one string value each.

name.description: Name identifies the object when other OpenSLO objects refer to it.

labels.description: Labels classifies the object with Kubernetes-style, single-valued labels.

annotations.description: Annotations attaches non-identifying metadata to the object.

Metadata.description: Metadata is the Kubernetes-style identifying metadata used by v2alpha objects.

dataSourceSpec.description: DataSourceSpec embeds the complete data-source connection configuration.

spec.description: Spec contains implementation-defined query configuration at the same level as the data-source selection.

SLIMetricSpec.description: SLIMetricSpec supplies an implementation-defined query in the v2alpha flattened layout.

counter.description:
Counter reports whether the good, bad, and total metrics are monotonically increasing counters.
It has no effect when Raw is used.

good.description: Good is the success-count numerator used with Total.

bad.description: Bad is the failure-count input used with Total to derive successes.

total.description: Total is the denominator paired with Good or Bad.

rawType.description: RawType identifies whether Raw contains a success or failure ratio when Raw is used.

raw.description: Raw supplies an already computed ratio.

SLIRatioMetric.description: SLIRatioMetric defines an indicator as SLIRatioMetric.Good divided by SLIRatioMetric.Total, (SLIRatioMetric.Total minus SLIRatioMetric.Bad) divided by SLIRatioMetric.Total, or SLIRatioMetric.Raw.

thresholdMetric.description:
ThresholdMetric defines a query that returns raw values.
[SLOObjective.Operator] compares each value with [SLOObjective.Value].

ratioMetric.description: RatioMetric defines component queries or a precomputed ratio for an SLO objective.

SLISpec.description: SLISpec defines the query or queries used to calculate an SLI.

SLOAlertPolicy.description: An alert policy that can be provided inline or as a reference.

startTime.description: StartTime is the local date and time when calendar alignment starts.

timeZone.description: TimeZone determines how StartTime maps to an instant.

SLOCalendar.description: SLOCalendar defines the starting wall-clock time and time zone for a calendar-aligned SLOTimeWindow.

displayName.description:
DisplayName is a human-readable name for this objective.
It is not part of the enclosing object's [Metadata].

op.description: Operator compares a threshold metric with Value.

value.description: Value is the comparison threshold for a threshold metric.

target.description:
Target is the desired success proportion.
For example, 0.995 means 99.5 percent.

targetPercent.description: TargetPercent is the desired success percentage.

timeSliceTarget.description: TimeSliceTarget sets the per-slice success threshold for Timeslices.

timeSliceWindow.description:
TimeSliceWindow sets the size of each slice for Timeslices and RatioTimeslices.
OpenSLO also accepts a number interpreted as minutes.
This SDK represents only duration shorthand.

sli.description: SLI embeds this objective's service level indicator for a composite SLO.

sliRef.description: SLIRef names this objective's existing [SLI] for a composite SLO.

compositeWeight.description:
CompositeWeight scales this objective's contribution to a composite SLO.
The living v2alpha proposal defaults it to 1, but this SDK preserves an omitted value as nil.

SLOObjective.description: SLOObjective defines one error-budget target and, for a threshold SLI, its metric comparison.

SLOSLIInline.description: SLOSLIInline embeds an SLI definition in an SLO or one of its objectives.

serviceRef.description:
ServiceRef names the service associated with this SLO.
The SDK serializes the field as "serviceRef".
The living v2alpha proposal calls it "service".

sli.description: SLI embeds the service level indicator for a standard SLO.

sliRef.description: SLIRef names an existing [SLI] for a standard SLO.

budgetingMethod.description: BudgetingMethod applies the selected error-budget calculation to every objective.

timeWindow.description: TimeWindow defines the period over which the SLO is evaluated.

objectives.description: Objectives contains the SLO's budget targets and metric thresholds.

alertPolicies.description: AlertPolicies contains inline alert policies or references to existing [AlertPolicy] objects.

SLOSpec.description: SLOSpec defines an SLO's service, SLI, time window, budgeting method, objectives, and alert policies.

duration.description: Duration is the length of the evaluation window.

isRolling.description: IsRolling selects a rolling window when true and a calendar-aligned window when false.

calendar.description: Calendar defines the alignment of a calendar window.

SLOTimeWindow.description: SLOTimeWindow describes one rolling or calendar-aligned evaluation window.

description: SLO defines a target for an SLI over a time window.
